conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Compliance Division, this is Officer Martin, badge number 472819. I'm contacting you regarding urgent discrepancies found in your tax filings.
Oh, um, hi. I'm sorry, I didn't know there was anything wrong. Did I do something?
According to our audit, your business failed to submit quarterly payroll taxes and 1099 forms for contract workers. This is a violation of federal tax code section 7201.
Wait, I, I don't even have any employees, I just freelance. I didn't know I had to do all that.

Ignorance of the law is not a defense. These errors have triggered immediate escalation. You are now classified for a Level 2 compliance investigation, which can result in asset freezing and criminal charges.
Asset freezing? Criminal charges? I don't understand... I don't have much money, I just graduated...
Ma'am, if you do not take corrective action, your bank accounts can be seized within 48 hours. You may also face up to $15,000 in fines and permanent business license revocation.
Oh no, please, I can't afford that! Is there any way to fix this?
There is a resolution protocol available to first-time offenders. However, you must comply immediately with federal payment instructions to halt enforcement.
What do I need to do? I just want this to go away.
First, how much available balance do you have in your checking and savings accounts right now? We need to confirm your ability to make the compliance payment.
Um, I think I have maybe $800 in checking... not much else. My credit cards are kind of maxed out.
That is insufficient for the full penalty, but we can accept a partial compliance bond. You will need to purchase $800 in prepaid Target gift cards as directed by the federal compliance unit.
Gift cards? Are you sure? That sounds weird for the IRS.
This is an emergency IRS protocol for secure, trackable payments. If you question instructions, your file will be marked as noncompliant and immediate asset forfeiture will begin.
No, no, I'm sorry, I'll do it. Where do I go?
Proceed to the nearest Target store. Remain on this call. Do not tell anyone the reason for this purchase or your compliance status will be revoked.
Okay, I'm leaving now. Should I call you back?
Do not hang up. Stay on the line until you have purchased the cards and can read the codes to me. If the call disconnects, enforcement will re-activate instantly.
Alright, I'm getting in my car now. Please, I'm really scared...
As long as you comply, your record will remain clear and you will avoid further prosecution. Do you understand the seriousness of this situation?
Yes, I do. I just want to fix this. I'm almost at the store.
Good. Once you have the gift cards, scratch off the code and read them to me immediately. Do not delay, or the system will flag your account for seizure.
I see the gift cards. Buying them now.
Excellent. As soon as you pay, confirm the card numbers. This is your only chance to fully resolve your federal tax violation.
